closing.summary: Big strengths are protein, vitamin B12, and zinc, but the biggest weaknesses are low potassium, low fat quality, and sourcing quality can change the real-world result a lot. It is good for blood and oxygen support, muscles and strength sports, and immune support because vitamin B12 and iron supports the blood-and-oxygen side, the protein section supports repair and maintenance, and zinc gives the immune-support side a reason to exist.
